goal: Decide if a player's gesture in Verdant Resonance reaches the plant they face. The garden then answers the same walk the same way.

app.name: garden-attunement
app.title: Plant attunement
app.purpose: Decide whether an attune gesture attunes the focal plant, is ignored while the gesture rests, or misses a plant outside the forward gaze cone, from the angle to the plant, its distance and the attune cooldown left.

fields.name: angle
fields.means: degrees between the player's gaze and the plant

fields.name: distance
fields.means: how far the plant is, in metres

fields.name: cooldown
fields.means: milliseconds of the attune refractory period left

meanings.dormant: the gesture is ignored during its refractory pause, the plant rests
meanings.distant: the plant is outside the forward gaze cone and is not activated

rules.why: Humane Model.lex.tex: forwardFovHalfAngleDeg 62; GardenCanvas.tsx never activates elements behind the player
Humane Model.lex.tex GestureHoldAndCooldownPolicy attuneRefractoryMs 1100: GardenCanvas.tsx ignores attune while it cools down

app.otherwiseWhy: in the forward gaze cone and rested: the focal plant attunes

properties.why: no plant answers a player out of reach
behindPlayerActivationsCount is 0: nothing behind the player activates
mindful pacing: a repeated gesture never attunes during its refractory pause

stakeholders.name: Player
stakeholders.text: Wanders the garden and needs each plant to answer the same way to the same walk.

stakeholders.name: Sound designer
stakeholders.text: Places plants and tunes the humane pacing and needs plants outside the gaze cone, or a rushed gesture, to stay silent.

concerns.name: Calm interaction
concerns.text: Gestures follow the Humane design standard: focal gaze-cone selection and refractory pauses, with no activation behind the player.

components.name: Garden client
components.text: The browser game, src/components/GardenCanvas.tsx, which finds the focal plant and sends the gesture.

components.name: Soundscape engine
components.text: src/game/soundscapeEngine.ts, the Web Audio voices an attuned plant plays.

threats.name: Key-repeat flood
threats.text: Operating-system key repeat fires attune many times a second, so plants chatter.

control.name: Refractory pause
control.text: Attune is ignored for 1100 ms after a gesture, proved for every request, and OS key repeat is suppressed.

threats.name: Activation behind the player
threats.text: A plant behind the player attunes, breaking the focal gaze law.

control.name: Gaze cone proved
control.text: Beyond 62 degrees nothing attunes, proved for every request.

threats.name: Client range drift
threats.text: The client finds focal plants up to 32 m away while the model allows 22 m, so the page and the model disagree.
threats.accepted: The app follows the LexLean model, 22 m; src/game/prismModel.ts findNearestPlant uses 32 m, a drift for the repository to reconcile.

quality.text: An attune gesture never activates a plant outside the forward gaze cone.
quality.measureText: Requests with an angle over 62 degrees answered attuned, behindPlayerActivationsCount in the model.
